head: 1a37789
equal_width_tradeoff_recommendation: YIELD-TO-259 — equal-width gating converts a surfaced, inspectable ragged extraction into the zero-content outcome #262 exists to prevent; reuse #259's structural-defect surfacing while separately rejecting phantoms.

findings.what: The strict predicate still accepts phantom grids: a Markdown table inside a fenced code block suppresses D3; so do a separator row in the middle of a pipe block and a header+separator+separator block with no data body.
findings.why: The scanner is fence-blind, accepts a separator at any index rather than the Markdown header boundary, and treats another separator as the required body row. I drove each through the real _winning_page_output: all three returned WARNING model content with MARKER_FIRED=False. These are attempts containing table-shaped syntax, not usable page-table extractions, so the fail-closed marker is still suppressible by a phantom. Require the separator to be row 2 of the candidate grid, require a non-separator body row, and ignore fenced blocks (or parse only actual Markdown table blocks).

findings.what: Equal row widths rejects a genuine ragged grid and ships zero content, contradicting the merged #259 owner ruling that the same structural defect is surfaced while the extraction is kept.
findings.why: At src/socr/core/manifest.py:302-319, kept_table_grid_defect explicitly runs the structural predicate for surfacing, never gating; tests/test_gh259_flagged_model_table_wins.py:605-630 pins a ragged grid as WARNING content with an in-body grid-shape flag. D3 is more alarming, but that supports stronger surfacing and the retained PNG, not reverting to a zero-content marker when genuine rows exist.

what_i_tried_to_break: Passed the isolation canary with PYTHONPATH pinned to the PR worktree. Probed prose with adjacent pipes, header+separator/no body, one column, ragged widths, single-dash separators, separator in the middle, leading/trailing/no outer pipes, fenced code, and separator-as-body. The intended negatives were blocked, but fenced code, a middle separator, and separator-as-body all qualified and suppressed D3. Reran the full round-3 test file against detached round-2 head 1d87a5a: exactly 3 behavioural failures (prose shipped, half-grid shipped, strict predicate absent), 29 passed, with no ImportError/AttributeError/TypeError; worktree removed. At head, 107 focused tests covering #262, #259, GH-205, tables trust, and #263 passed. The loose find_table_blocks diff is additive-only and has_strict_table_grid has only the D3 caller. No numeric-multiset or decimal-count correctness oracle was added. The main merge retains #263/#265 rotation guards and #260 rejection_class behavior in the focused suite. audit_passed remains demoted only on the returned copy; CERTAIN_FAIL remains blocked; the note, PNG, prose and equation preservation tests pass.
